name: Analyze Node Statistics
description: Provides a plugin for analyzing node statistics
project_description: Analyze Node Statistics (machine name analyze_page_views) is a submodule of Analyze that ships a single Analyze plugin, NodeViews (id "node_views"), surfacing a node's page-view counts on its Analyze tab. The counts come straight from core's Statistics module: the plugin injects the statistics.storage.node service (Drupal\statistics\NodeStatisticsDatabaseStorage) and calls fetchView($nid), which reads the core node_counter table, then renders a two-row summary table of Total views and Today's count. It is applicable only to node entities, provides no full report, and gates its own access on the Statistics module's "view post access counter" permission. It depends on analyze, node and statistics, and adds no routes, services or configuration of its own.
